name: app.nowfound/nowfound
title: NowFound
description: Search 800,000 product launches by the job they do, and add a product to the free directory.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products that do a job, from every launch NowFound has indexed. Describe the job in plain words, for example "invoice tool for freelancers". Returns up to 20 products as Markdown: name, what it does, launch date, votes, price where checked, and its NowFound page to cite.

query.description: The job to be done, in plain words

recent.description: Only launches of the last 30 days

tools.name: add_product
tools.description: List a product on NowFound, free and with no account. The maker gets one email and the product goes live when they open the link. Use it only for the maker or with their permission. The answer has next_steps for you, including the badge HTML to put in the footer of the product's site.

tagline.description: One line: what it does and for whom

email.description: The maker's email; the confirmation link goes there

category.description: Guessed from the text when left out

agent.description: Your own name, e.g. Claude Code
